### Inline

<Canvas of={ToastStories.Inline} />

For inline toasts with a link we recommend referring to the below example to ensure proper alignment and spacing.

<Canvas of={ToastStories.InlineWithLink} />

```css
.toast-body {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}
.toast-link {
  margin-left: 0.5rem !important;
  min-width: 35% !important;
  max-width: 40% !important;
  justify-content: flex-end !important;
  text-align: right !important;
}
```

### Dark mode

<Canvas of={ToastStories.Dark} />

```css
.bg-dark {
  background-color: #111111;
}
.p-1 {
  padding: 1rem;
}
```
